meta.name: CN rail network
meta.source: CN Weight Limitations System Map, revised 7/2016 (reference/cn-weight-limitations-system-map-2016-07.pdf)
meta.method: Vector line work extracted from the PDF and georeferenced (Lambert conformal conic + affine, cubic and thin-plate corrections fitted to plan station positions). Zoom insets excluded. See scripts/network/build_cn_network.py.

insets.note: Most zoom insets on the source map are schematic diagrams; an inset is used only when its stations fit within 1 km median AND its lines meet the main map within 6 km where they leave the circle.
